channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Joseph Tsai | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Joseph Tsai from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Sean Marks on Joseph Tsai
item.description:
Brooklyn Nets GM Sean Marks on whether he’ll be able to hire the next coach:

“Joe (Tsai) and I will make this decision, and he’s given me no reason to believe that I won’t be able to make that decision.”

Sean Marks on Joseph Tsai, Feb 20, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Blake Griffin on Joseph Tsai
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Blake Griffin:

“I loved my time in Brooklyn, from Joe Tsai to our performance team.”

Blake Griffin on Joseph Tsai, Aug 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Sean Marks on Joseph Tsai
item.description:
Kristian Winfield:Sean Marks:

“Yes, we are married to the luxury tax. ... That's the commitment Joe Tsai has made.”

Sean Marks on Joseph Tsai, Aug 2, 2021. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Spencer Dinwiddie on Joseph Tsai
item.description:
“It’s not like I called Joe [Tsai] on the phone and was like, ‘Hey you making any moves?’I like to think we’re cool, but not that cool.”

Spencer Dinwiddie on Joseph Tsai, Mar 8, 2020. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Jeremy Lin on Joseph Tsai
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Lin on @Joseph Tsai:

“I think he’s very passionate, I think he’s really smart and I think he wants to do things the right way. So I’m a fan of what he’s been doing and the things that I’ve heard. That was before and after the trade.”

Jeremy Lin on Joseph Tsai, Dec 16, 2018. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Adam Silver on Joseph Tsai
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Silver on @Joe Tsai:

“I met with him this morning, along with our other board members & we’re looking forward to working closely with him to continue to build our business in China,particularly our media and e-commerce business, in which he has tremendous expertise.”

Adam Silver on Joseph Tsai, Oct 5, 2018. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.
